pairs: Deus meus es tu; exaltabo te,
you are my God! I will exalt you,
and I will confess your name.
Your plan, from antiquity, is faithful.
For you have appointed a city as a tomb,
so that it may not be a city,
and so that it may not be rebuilt forever.
Super hoc laudabit te populus fortis;
Concerning this, a strong people will praise you;
a city with a robust people will fear you.
For you have been the strength of the poor,
the strength of the indigent in his tribulation,
spiritus enim robustorum quasi turbo impellens parietem.
For the spirit of the mighty is like a whirlwind striking against a wall.
You will bring low the uprising of foreigners,
et quasi calore sub nube torrente,
And like heat under a torrential cloud,
you will cause the offshoot of the strong to wither away.
Et faciet Dominus exercituum omnibus populis in monte hoc convivium pinguium,
And the Lord of hosts will cause all the peoples on this mountain to feast on fatness,
Et præcipitabit in monte isto faciem vinculi colligati super omnes populos, et telam quam orditus est super omnes nationes.
And he will cast down violently, on this mountain, the face of the chains, with which all peoples had been bound, and the net, with which all nations had been covered.
He will violently cast down death forever.
et auferet Dominus Deus lacrimam ab omni facie,
And the Lord God will take away the tears from every face,
et opprobrium populi sui auferet de universa terra:
and he will take away the disgrace of his people from the entire earth.
For the Lord has spoken it.
And they will say in that day:
We will exult and rejoice in his salvation.”
Quia requiescet manus Domini in monte isto;
For the hand of the Lord will rest upon this mountain.
And Moab will be trampled under him,
just as stubble is worn away by a wagon.
Et extendet manus suas sub eo sicut extendit natans ad natandum;
And he will extend his hands under him, like a swimmer extending his hands to swim.
et humiliabit gloriam ejus cum allisione manuum ejus.
And he will bring down his glory with a clap of his hands.
Et munimenta sublimium murorum tuorum concident,
And the fortifications of your sublime walls will fall,
et detrahentur in terram usque ad pulverem.
and be torn down to the ground, even to the dust.
